item.title: Duran Duran returning to Las Vegas Strip for 4 nights
item.description: English pop rock band Duran Duran announced it would be returning to the Las Vegas Strip this May.

item.title: Nevada sees increase in active registered voters in January
item.description: The state of Nevada saw an increase of over 12,000 active registered voters during the month of January, according to Nevada Secretary of State Francisco Aguilar.

item.title: Lawsuit: Excessive force in North Las Vegas jail led to miscarriage
item.description: A woman has filed a federal lawsuit against the City of North Las Vegas after she said excessive force inside the jail led her to miscarry.

item.title: Power of Love gala in Las Vegas fuels man's personal mission of hope for Alzheimer's patients, families
item.description: The stars will be out on Valentine's Day as The Power of Love gala brings celebrities and community leaders together for a good cause — raising money for the Cleveland Clinic Lou Ruvo Center for Brain Health in Las Vegas.

item.title: Nevada trooper shoots at Montana woman after gun pointed in Las Vegas stop
item.description: A Montana woman pointed a gun at a Nevada state trooper with her finger on the trigger, prompting the officer to shoot at her in Las Vegas early Sunday, the 8 News Now Investigators have learned.

item.title: The Smith Center announces 2026-2027 Las Vegas season featuring award-winning Broadway musicals
item.description: The Smith Center for the Performing Arts announced its 2026-2027 season of its popular and acclaimed Toyota Broadway Las Vegas Series.

item.title: Family of teen hit, killed says Las Vegas neighborhood is neglected by city
item.description: The family of 17-year-old Eric Estrada Jimenez is demanding justice after he was struck and killed by an RV while walking to his sister’s home in the east Las Vegas valley Saturday evening, according to his family.

item.title: Impaired Tesla driver hits UK family, flees scene: Las Vegas police
item.description: A man, who was driving a Tesla, is facing DUI and hit-and-run charges after police say he struck a car and three pedestrians, including a toddler.
